evidence.quote:
SECTION 1. The issuance of any and all zoning permits and other approvals allowing the development,
construction, or operation of any new Large-Scale Data Centers is hereby suspended for a period of twelve (12)
months from the effective date of this Resolution—which suspension shall expire on May 20, 2027 (the
“Moratorium’”).

SECTION 2. To the extent there are any existing Large-Scale Data Centers in Hamilton Township as of
the effective date of this Resolution, the issuance of any and all zoning permits and other approvals allowing the
expansion or enlargement of such existing facilities is hereby suspended for the period of the Moratorium.

SECTION 3. The Moratorium shall not apply to applications or zoning permits related to the

development, construction, or operation of a Large-Scale Data Center where such applications or permits were
submitted or issued prior to the effective date of this Resolution.
evidence.supports: Operative calendar term, explicit endpoint, expansion coverage and prior-application/permit exception.
